core_meaning.short_meaning: Cool refreshing breeze; companion Buraydah ibn al-Husayb al-Aslami.
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Buraydah (بُرَيْدَة) is an Arabic masculine given name meaning 'refreshing cool breeze', 'soothing relief', or 'delicate pearl of coolness'. In Islamic history, it is the renowned name of Buraydah ibn al-Husayb al-Aslami, the companion who met the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ during the Hijrah with seventy riders of his tribe, embraced Islam instantly, and raised his turban as a white banner of peace.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Diminutive of bardah (coolness, pleasant breeze), symbolizing peace, tranquility, and the alleviation of burning desert heat.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: During the Hijrah, Buraydah and seventy men rode out to capture the Prophet ﷺ. When the Prophet asked his name and he replied 'Buraydah' (coolness), the Prophet turned to Abu Bakr and said: 'Your matter has become cool and easy.' When he asked about his tribe and he said 'Aslam' (peace), the Prophet said: 'You are saved.' Buraydah and all seventy men accepted Islam on the spot.
